arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
from parse import extract_format

# Test R3: sign specifiers in number format specifications
print('Testing R3 (sign specifiers)...')

# Sign before width
fmt1 = extract_format('+10d', {})
print('  \"+10d\": type=', fmt1['type'], ', width=', fmt1.get('width'), ', align=', fmt1.get('align'))

# Sign after zero padding
fmt2 = extract_format('0+10d', {})
print('  \"0+10d\": type=', fmt2['type'], ', width=', fmt2.get('width'), ', zero=', fmt2.get('zero'))

# Just a sign with no width
fmt3 = extract_format('+d', {})
print('  \"+d\": type=', fmt3['type'])

# Negative sign
fmt4 = extract_format('-5d', {})
print('  \"-5d\": type=', fmt4['type'], ', width=', fmt4.get('width'))

# Parse with signed numbers
r = parse.parse('{x:+d}', '+42')
print('  {x:+d} with \"+42\":', r.named if r else None)

r2 = parse.parse('{x:-d}', '-42')
print('  {x:-d} with \"-42\":', r2.named if r2 else None)
"
